heading_en: Aggregation of Market Risk Equivalent Amounts
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式及び標準的方式に基づくマーケット・リスク相当額の合算の算式（ACR_{total}、資本サーチャージ、C_{A}、k）と、各変数の意義を定める。
summary_en: Sets the formula for aggregating market risk equivalent amounts under the internal model approach and the standardized approach (ACR_{total}, the capital surcharge, C_{A} and k), and defines each variable.
paragraphs: The market risk equivalent amount based on the internal model approach and the standardized approach shall be calculated using the following formula. ACR_{total} = min{IMA_{G,A} + capital surcharge + C_{U}; SA_{alldesk}} + max{0; IMA_{G,A} − SA_{G,A}} C_{A} = max{IMCC_{t−1} + SES_{t−1}; m_{c}・IMCC_{avg} + SES_{avg}} Capital surcharge = k・max{0, SA_{G,A} − IMA_{G,A}} {{F:p347i0}} ACR_{total} is the market risk equivalent amount based on the internal model approach and the standardized approach; IMA_{G,A} is the sum of C_{A} and DRC; DRC is the market risk equivalent amount for default risk in trading desks using the internal model approach, calculated under Article 255, paragraph (2); C_{U} is the market risk equivalent amount calculated using the standardized approach for trading desks not using the internal model approach; SA_{alldesk} is the market risk equivalent amount where calculated using the standardized approach for all trading desks; SA_{G,A} is the market risk equivalent amount where calculated using the standardized approach for trading desks classified in the green zone (G) or amber zone (A) under Article 253-8, paragraph (1); SA_{A} is the market risk equivalent amount where calculated using the standardized approach for trading desks classified in the amber zone (A) under Article 253-8, paragraph (1); C_{A} is the sum of the capital charges under the internal model approach other than DRC; IMCC_{t−1} is the IMCC as of the calculation reference date (meaning the market risk equivalent amount for modellable risk factors under Article 254-4; the same applies hereinafter in this Article); SES_{t−1} is the SES as of the calculation reference date (meaning the market risk equivalent amount for non-modellable risk factors under Article 254-5, paragraph (2); the same applies hereinafter in this Article); m_{c} is the multiplier set out in the middle column of the table in Article 253-2, paragraph (4), or that multiplier plus a qualitative add-on designated by the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency; IMCC_{avg} is the average of the IMCC over the most recent 60 business days including the calculation reference date; SES_{avg} is the average of the SES over the most recent 60 business days including the calculation reference date; SA_{i} is the market risk equivalent amount where calculated using the standardized approach for trading desk i.
